processingCapabilities.label: Pitch
processingCapabilities.ntLimit: One shared stereo parameter; ordinary NT parameter mapping supplies modulation.

processingCapabilities.label: Stretch
processingCapabilities.range: 1.0 (real time) to 0.0 (freeze), using the upstream (1-x)^2.5 control taper
processingCapabilities.ntLimit: One shared stereo parameter; no independent transport-speed control.

processingCapabilities.label: Threshold
processingCapabilities.range: adaptive envelope-average ratio 0 to 8; top-of-range disables automatic triggers
processingCapabilities.ntLimit: Shared by input and output detectors; only input kept events trigger a splice.

processingCapabilities.label: Grain Size
processingCapabilities.ntLimit: Integer keyframe leash, shared by both channels.

processingCapabilities.label: Quality
processingCapabilities.ntLimit: Shared by both channels; the displayed direction must preserve clockwise=finer.

processingCapabilities.label: Feedback
processingCapabilities.ntLimit: Shared stereo control; values above 1.0 are intentionally unstable, with upstream injection clamped to +/-1.

processingCapabilities.label: Envelope Smoothing
processingCapabilities.range: normalized cutoff 0.00005 to 0.125 (approximately 1.2 Hz to 3 kHz at 48 kHz), exponential
processingCapabilities.ntLimit: Shared by input and output analysis; frequency figures are valid only at the pinned 48 kHz baseline.

processingCapabilities.label: Fade
processingCapabilities.range: 10 to 250 ms (480 to 12000 frames at 48 kHz), exponential
processingCapabilities.ntLimit: The same value controls OLA crossfade, wet latency, and automatic-trigger retrigger floor.

processingCapabilities.label: Drive
processingCapabilities.ntLimit: Applied to sparse keyframes, shared by both channels.

processingCapabilities.label: Drive Character
processingCapabilities.ntLimit: Continuous morph; shared by both channels.

processingCapabilities.label: Mix
processingCapabilities.ntLimit: The wet path is delayed by Fade, so intermediate values may comb with sustained input.

processingCapabilities.label: Feedback Tone
processingCapabilities.range: normalized bandpass center 0.002 to 0.9 (approximately 48 Hz to 21.6 kHz at 48 kHz), exponential
processingCapabilities.ntLimit: Shared stereo feedback-path control; frequency figures are valid only at the pinned 48 kHz baseline.

processingCapabilities.label: Slice
processingCapabilities.ntLimit: UI action only; version 1 adds no dedicated trigger-CV input.

analysisSignals.label: Input Transient
analysisSignals.ntLimit: Optional 0/5 V CV output assignment; selector 0 means disconnected.

analysisSignals.label: Output Transient
analysisSignals.ntLimit: Optional 0/5 V CV output assignment; selector 0 means disconnected; never triggers a splice.

analysisSignals.label: Input Envelope
analysisSignals.ntLimit: Optional 0-5 V CV output assignment; selector 0 means disconnected.

analysisSignals.label: Output Envelope
analysisSignals.ntLimit: Optional 0-5 V CV output assignment; selector 0 means disconnected.

sampleSourceBoundary.classification: NT wrapper source adapter, not an upstream sampler capability
sampleSourceBoundary.acceptedCatalog: Only files enumerated by the pinned NT sample-folder APIs
sampleSourceBoundary.metadata: uint32 frame count and sample rate; mono or stereo; 8-, 16-, 24-bit PCM or 32-bit float as represented by _NT_wavInfo
sampleSourceBoundary.conversion: The pinned streaming API supplies stereo float frames at the wrapper's file sample rate / host sample rate speed; mono is duplicated by the host stream and stereo preserves channel order.
sampleSourceBoundary.wrapperLimits: The full host-supported file streams through API-sized per-instance state and buffer memory rather than a full-file allocation. It loops while Sample mode is active because there is no transport trigger. Entering Sample or changing Folder opens the current valid selection; Folder changes synchronize Sample to the visible legal range. Loop recovery is limited to one reopen per audio block, and an unexpected short render drops the remaining frames instead of performing unbounded SD work. Unsupported or unreadable files remain host errors.

excludedUpstreamSurface.reason: The approved wrapper uses ordinary NT parameter mapping instead of Capicola's Alchemy-panel depth/routing pages.
Dedicated processing-control CV inputs are out of scope for version 1.
KeyframeRecorder RECORDING and PLAYBACK states are internal engine mechanisms, not an approved user-facing sampler transport.
Upstream diagnostic telemetry is not an audio-processing capability or first-release user feature.
The upstream engine setter is not exposed by Capicola's audited panel UI and its uncapped range is not part of the first-release surface.
